name: Elias Virtanen
bio:
Elias grew up around rally tracks in central Finland, spending his weekends helping his uncle maintain a small privateer team's Ford Escort. He studied mechanical engineering at Tampere University of Technology, focusing on engine design and aerodynamics. After graduating, he joined a small engineering consultancy working on various motorsport projects before landing a role at ART Grand Prix five years ago.

As Head of Operations, Elias is known for his meticulous planning and calm demeanor under pressure. He excels at optimizing logistical workflows and ensuring smooth communication between the engineering, pit crew, and driver teams. He's a firm believer in data-driven decision-making and consistently seeks innovative solutions to improve operational efficiency. His pragmatic approach and ability to troubleshoot complex problems quickly make him a valuable asset to the team.

Elias is particularly passionate about fostering a collaborative environment where team members feel empowered to share ideas and contribute their expertise. He believes that a strong team culture is essential for achieving consistent success in the high-pressure world of motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly parted on the left
physical.description: Elias is of average height, with a slightly athletic build and a focused look in his eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in meetings.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on using Finnish coffee beans for the team's coffee machine.
